items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: I remember the one with Page, on the street, I have no idea what street

ctx.x: Because if someone was telling you—

Then there’d be no point to it. I mean if like somebody’s going to tell me what Basie record to play, that’s kind of silly. I mean if Jo Jones told me to play it, that’s fine. But I mean that’s weird. I mean Herschel Evans died before I was born. Everybody else I met, most of them were close friends. I mean I even met Walter Page at six, and I think I met Jack Washington when he was in town when I was seven. It was real hello-goodbye quick with Jo Jones, but I was there. I remember the one with Page, on the…
That’s great. When did you have an opportunity to do some writing in liner notes and all those kinds of things?
